info.title: HELIX Connect API
info.description:
OpenAPI specification for a HELIX-conformant server. Defines REST endpoints for HELIX Core resources across all 9 domains: Student Identity, Academic Structure, Enrollment, Financial Aid, Outcomes, Student Services, Advancement, Financial Operations, and Human Resources.

A conformant server exposes read endpoints for HELIX Core resources, write endpoints for data submission, and bulk export for data lake ingestion. OAuth 2.0 scopes enforce data classification and FERPA/GLBA access controls.

get.description:
Initiates an asynchronous bulk export of one or more resource types. Returns NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON) files. Async bulk export operation.

The server returns a 202 Accepted with a Content-Location header pointing to a status endpoint. Poll the status endpoint until the export is complete, then download the resulting NDJSON files.

parameters.name: _type
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of resource types to export (e.g., 'Student,Enrollment'). If omitted, all supported resources are exported.

parameters.name: _since
parameters.description: Only include resources updated after this timestamp. Enables incremental exports.

parameters.name: _outputFormat
parameters.description: Output format. NDJSON is required for conformance. Parquet is optional but recommended for lake ingestion.

202.description: Export initiated. Poll the Content-Location URL for status.

Content-Location.description: URL to poll for export status

429.description: Too many concurrent exports. Retry after the indicated delay.

200.description: Export complete. Response includes download URLs for each resource type.

202.description: Export still in progress. Retry after the indicated delay.

pageToken.name: page_token
pageToken.description: Opaque token for the next page of results

updatedSince.name: updated_since
updatedSince.description: Only return resources updated after this timestamp (for incremental sync)

Unauthorized.description: Authentication required. Provide a valid OAuth2 token or API key.

Forbidden.description: Insufficient permissions. The requested resource or data classification level is not authorized for this client.

NotFound.description: Resource not found for the given HELIX ID.

helix_version.description: HELIX Core spec version this server conforms to

supported_operations.description: Operations this server supports. 'read' and 'search' are required. 'export' and 'validate' are recommended. 'write' is optional.

page_token.description: Token for the next page, null if no more results

url.description: Download URL for the NDJSON or Parquet file

count.description: Number of resources in the file

path.description: JSON path to the invalid field (e.g., '$.status')

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 with institution's identity provider. Recommended for production.

scopes.helix:read:hr: Read confidential HR data (employee, position, time)
scopes.helix:read:hr:restricted: Read restricted HR data (compensation, benefits, payroll, performance)
